title: cdt_ins (Inserter) — invocation + commands
text:
[MCP-DEPRECATED] MCP 内 ILA 流程使用 fpga_ila_generate_fic + fpga_pds_register_fic 两件套(纯代码生成 .fic + 注册到 .pds),不通过 cdt_ins 驱动。以下 cdt_ins 内容仅作排查/教学参考。 ## cdt_ins (Inserter) — invocation + commands `cdt_ins.exe -netlist -device -package

-speedgrade [-fic ] [-file ]` (do NOT pass `-batch`; an unknown flag makes it just print help and exit.) Tcl API: | command | purpose | |---|---| | `ins_new ` | new project (creates `.fic`) | | `ins_set_device -family -device -package -speedgrade` | target part — **example** values, replace with YOUR target (e.g. `-family Logos2 -device PG2L100H -package FBG484 -speedgrade -6`) | | `ins_set_file -input ` | input netlist (parses → populates net DB; ~30–60 s) | | `ins_list_nets` | print all tappable nets, ` : ` | | `ins_add_core ` / `ins_remove_core ` | add/remove debug cores | | `ins_set_core -core 0 -data_depth N -clock_edge Rising -trig_num 1 -data_same true` | core config | | `ins_operate -core 0` | select default target core | | `ins_set_net -connect -core 0 -clock ` | connect sample clock | | `ins_set_net -connect -core 0 -trig 0 -channel ` | connect a trigger/data channel | | `ins_set_trig / ins_set_unit / ins_set_condition / ins_set_capture` | trigger / match-unit / capture cfg | | `ins_core_info -core 0` | dump the core's RESOLVED config (use to verify) | | `ins_open ` / `ins_save ` | open / save `.fic` | **Big gotcha:** `ins_set_net` takes the net's **integer index**, not its name — and those indices are **not stable across processes** (a re-parse renumbers). So scripted index-based connects are unreliable. **Hand-write the `.fic` by net name** (names are the `.fic`'s native form), then validate with `ins_open`.
